Owner: the data team. Alert: the etl_nightly DAG failing in prod Airflow.

First checks

  1. Open the failed run in Airflow and find the task that failed, usually load_orders.

  2. Read that task’s log for the error line.

An order without customer_id

The load stops with ValueError: order NNNNN has no customer_id when an order reaches the warehouse before the CRM has given it a customer.

  1. Fix the order in the CRM: set its customer, then wait for the hourly customer sync.

  2. Then retry the load: clear load_orders for the failed run in Airflow.

  3. Re-run the search indexer orders-sql on srch-contoso-prod, so the order shows up in orders search.

Escalation

Alert: [prod] worker crash-looping in Datadog.

Cause

The worker cannot sign in to the orders database once its password has expired.

Fix

  1. Rotate kv-contoso-prod/worker-db-password in Key Vault and set the new value on the database.

  2. Restart the worker deployment in prod/web.

Tracked in work item 1219.
